evidence_kind: Static original DLL plus matching Engine PDB; no original execution.

arguments.Name: Cue string normalized by GetSoundCue: empty preserved, leading / or { preserved, otherwise prepend /. This direct action is not SGD literal-null deserialization.
arguments.Id: Source Thing ID; default-1, destination/object selectors are not used here.
arguments.Delay: Delay overrides DelaySeconds when nonnil; Min/Max aliases same existing ScriptArgs helper.
arguments.ManagerCap: Default0; only immediate path invokes native PlayCue3DWithCap.
arguments.AddCallbacks: Boolean; after actual immediate/delayed admission branch.

play_sound.rng: Only if (min>0 OR max>0) AND base>0 AND max>min invokes Deterministic.RandomFloat(min,max).
play_sound.positive_delay: Creates actual AudioChannel/ID NOW, queues Play(id) only via World.AddDelayedGameEvent, returns actual channelID.
play_sound.channel_ids: Shared nextID starts1 and increments after successful Create2D/3D.
play_sound.source_mode: Absent source or source==listener routes2D; other resolved source routes3D.

set_sound_cue_value.ids: ScriptArgs Id/Ids are audio channel IDs.
set_sound_cue_value.names: ScriptArgs Name/Names are PARAMETER names. No names => early return.
set_sound_cue_value.operation: Each parameter name over each selected channelID. Duration>0 creates parameter target rate1/duration; otherwise immediate setParameterByName(ignoreSeekSpeed=false), status ignored.
set_sound_cue_value.native_absent: Guitar/Bass absent on opening music are real missing parameters and immediate errors ignored, no invented controls.
set_sound_cue_value.timed_absent: AudioManager.Update VA18004be67 initializes current parameter output0;4be87 ignores getParameterByName status;4be98 compares output to target;4bef7 ignores setter status. Missing target0 counts as complete; a nonzero missing target remains queued and retries from0 each update without synthesizing a parameter.4bf2f compares completed count with whole channel target count: target group retires only when all values already matched at frame start.
set_sound_cue_value.fmod_missing_output: Shipped fmodstudio.dll SHA25690d6d809215666f86f2e5a156c17e8b04e5e0c7bd848e9fa7a8377e97576abb1 export EventInstance.getParameterByName VA180081e10 calls180078680. That function zeroes supplied output pointers at786ab/786b7 before name lookup; missing local name returns FMOD_RESULT74 at7882c without further output writes. Addresses resolved from current DLL exports/instructions, not its mismatched PDB.

pause_sound.ids: Duration<=0 pauses immediately; positive duration compares actual current volume to ZERO. If already0, pauses immediately; otherwise SetVolumeTarget(0,duration,false,true).
pause_sound.names: GetSoundCue returns pOwner=null in examined build; direct named-owner branch therefore cannot resolve a channel. No native scan over all matching live channels was found.
pause_sound.empty: Empty Ids and Names perform no channel operations.

resume_sound.ids: Duration<=0 ResumeCue. Positive duration reads actual current volume, ResumeCue always occurs first, then queues target1 only if current volume<1 (strict comparison at25d9d3..d6).
resume_sound.resume_cue: If channel.mStarted=false virtualPlay, preserving existing pause flag; otherwise setPaused(false).
resume_sound.names: Same GetSoundCue.pOwner caveat; name branch alone does not establish channel-name matching.

stop_sound.ids: Duration<=0 calls FMOD.stop(mode0 allowfadeout). Positive Duration: if actual current volume>0 queue target0 with stopOnEnd=true,pauseOnEnd=false; otherwise if paused ResumeCue, then FMOD.stop(mode0).
stop_sound.names: Nonpositive branch uses GetSoundCue owner null caveat. PositiveDuration code iterates IDs; no positive-duration Name lookup callsite.

set_volume.names: Nonpositive branch GetSoundCue owner null caveat. PositiveDuration branch has no Name lookup callsite.

named_owner_proof.get_cue: GetSoundCue VA180054a47 unconditionally stores returned SoundCue.pOwner=0; name/valid assigned separately.
named_owner_proof.pause: Name path GetSoundCue25d7a1, reads returned owner25d7c3 then tests25d7c7.
named_owner_proof.resume: Name path GetSoundCue25db54 then reads owner25db77 and tests25db7b.
named_owner_proof.caution: channelIds(exactName) is a portable metadata query, not proof that native Name-based script controls select all matching live instances.

music_marker.fresh_args: OnMusicMarker constructs TriggerArgs then inserts Position integer using original FMOD milliseconds; generic Script.run(0,markerName,args) supplies common dispatch fields. No channelID inserted here.
music_marker.automatic: AudioChannelBase Init attaches marker callback for source name beginning /Music/ even without AddCallbacks; ScriptPlaySound AddCallbacks can install all callback mask after admission.

manager_cap.ordinary_3d: Non-VO rejected only when per-frame count>=SfxFrameCap. ManagerCap compares total manager channel-vector size, not same cue count, but does not independently reject while framecount below cap.

SoundAllowedAfterFrame gate applies before call.

Only when frameAllowed and totalCount<uint64(int64(suppliedCap)) skips VO lookup; otherwise VO admits, then frameAllowed decides regularSFX. Supplied cap never bypasses frame cap for regular location SFX, and no Thing.HighPriority field participates. Location wrapper4aa90 uses exactXY equality againstzero/listener for2D.
